posts.title: Observability Is a Testing Strategy
posts.description: A test is an assertion about how a system should behave. An alert is exactly the same thing - it just runs in production, against real traffic, forever. Most teams don’t see it that way. Tests belong to developers, live in the repository and get reviewed. Alerts belong to ops or SRE, live in a dashboard and get added after an incident, without anyone reviewing them. Two worlds, two owners. In Shif

posts.title: Code Review Is a Social Technology
posts.description: Every team I know does code review. Very few have ever asked themselves what they are actually doing when they do it. On paper it’s a simple practice: before a change lands on the main branch, somebody who didn’t write it reads it.
